text: 西尔维娅舀了一碗汤递给这位归来的浪子。他的脸因恐惧而扭曲，挥手打翻热汤，汤汁溅在灰绿色地衣上。
“太……太冷了，没法觉得饿。”伯纳德喃喃道，“我睡觉去。”
“不，”伯纳德低声说，“我就在那儿休息。”他指向远离火堆的黑暗角落。你没有说什么，任由他躺在冰冷的苔藓上。
伯纳德的举止令你不安；守夜时，你一直留心观察他。他脚上的绷带让你放心不下。回麦克唐纳堡还有很长的路，你本该替他换掉绷带。
趁睡着时悄悄靠近那名学生，检查他的绷带，前往204。让他安静休息，结束守夜后前往179。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 139
text: Sylvia ladles up a bowl of soup and offers it to the prodigal. His face twists in horror and he bats the warm broth away, spilling it on the gray-green lichen.
“It’s… too cold to have hunger,” Bernard mumbles. “I will sleep.”
You ask Norman to fetch some bedding.
“No,” Bernard rumbles, “I will rest there.” He points to a dark corner away from the fire. You say nothing and let him stretch out on the chill moss.
Perturbed by Bernard’s behavior, you keep an eye on him while you stand watch. The bandages on his feet bother you. It is a long way back to Fort McDonald and you should have changed them.
To creep up on the sleeping student and examine his bandages, go to 204. To leave him to rest in peace, finish your watch and go to 179.
